report_discrepancies.note: Depreciation Fund Schedule C labels 110,108.17 '5200 Allocation from General Fund' (counted in Exhibit III Non-Revenue Receipts, p8), but the General Fund shows no matching disbursement or transfer out (its only transfer is 25,000 to School Nutrition). Recorded as printed: receipt, category other, with review and a decision_needed entry.

decision_needed.question: The Depreciation Fund shows 110,108.17 of 'Allocation from General Fund' (Schedule C, p19), included in Non-Revenue Receipts on Exhibit III, but the General Fund shows no matching disbursement or transfer (its only transfer is 25,000 to School Nutrition). Should this be treated as an interfund transfer (one-sided) rather than a receipt?
decision_needed.recorded_as: receipt, category other (Non-Revenue Receipts, Depreciation Fund column), flagged for review

notes: Modified cash basis school district; governmental funds only (General, Special Building, Depreciation, Activities, School Nutrition), so business_type, proprietary and reported_totals business-type are null. Receipts and disbursements are from Exhibit III Total Governmental Funds column (p9, p11); transfers in/out 25,000 are the General Fund to School Nutrition transfer (printed below total receipts and below total disbursements). Beginning and ending cash are the modified cash fund balances on p13 (ending equals Cash and Deposits 2,888,011.57 + County Treasurers' Balance 328,472.60 on p1). Local Receipts (2,204,126.00) split with split_from using the fund schedules: General local excluding interest 2,065,273.68 + Special Building 27,293.15 + Activities 109,909.04 + School Nutrition 1,650.13; County Receipts 6,067.20 split into fines 4,179.99 and ESU 1,887.21; Non-Revenue Receipts 177,010.73 split by fund column (57,671.67 General, 9,230.89 Special Building, 110,108.17 Depreciation). State Receipts kept whole as state aid (homestead, property tax credit, pro-rate motor vehicle and state programs, per Schedule A). Federal Receipts 225,512.03 = General 136,245.43 + Nutrition 89,266.60. Discrete component unit (Musical Instruments, Exhibit I and II) is excluded. Detail: General Fund spending uses Schedule M (program by object), which supersedes Schedule B (program totals only, same totals); object mapping: Salaries -> salaries and wages; Employee Benefits, Retirement, Increased Retirement -> employee benefits; Purchased Professional/Technical Services and Other Property Services -> professional/contract services; Purchased Property Services -> repairs and maintenance; Property -> equipment purchases; Other Items -> dues, training and travel. Programs 3400, 3551, 6200 and 6992 are classed as instruction (statement counts them under Private/State and Federal Programs). Zero-actual budget-only lines (2153, 2650, 6915 and similar) omitted. Schedule M total 3,860,430.74 includes the 25,000 transfer (shown as signed other financing line printed in expenditure). Schedule F (Activities) is a one-line schedule, not per-account; Schedule N (County Treasurers' General Fund) and Schedule A-1 not recorded as detail (reconciliation/summary). Read pages 1-30 of 30
